transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, my mom brought me. Mostly because I just... I can't really make myself do anything anymore. I spend all day sitting in my room, usually with the same clothes on. I used to do things, like knit or write in my journal, or go for walks, but I don't do any of that now. And when my mom comes in and asks what's wrong, I... I barely even have the energy to answer her.
Do you still find pleasure in the things you used to enjoy, like knitting or writing in your journal?

No, not really. Like I was saying, I just... I don't do them at all anymore. It's not even that I try and it isn't fun, it's just that I can't make myself start. I don't have the energy to care about my journal or my knitting. I just sit in my room in the same clothes. Even when my mom asks about it, I barely have it in me to answer her. So... no, I guess I don't really enjoy those things right now. I just don't have the energy for it.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
No, not really. I wouldn't say I feel sad. I don't cry or... feel upset about things. It's more just... I don't feel much of anything at all. It's just kind of blank.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure in things that would normally be enjoyable?

I guess so. I mean... like I said a minute ago, I don't really do those things at all anymore to even find out. I just don't feel much of anything. It's not like I try to have fun and it doesn't work, I just... I don't have any feeling about it either way. It's just blank.
Do you often think you're to blame for things or feel guilty?

No, I don't think so. I don't really feel guilty about anything. Like I said, I just don't feel much at all right now, so... no, I don't sit around feeling bad or blaming myself. It's just... nothing.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been a while. I guess this whole decline has been going on since I started the community-college program. That was... about two years and two months ago, I think.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to, or have people told you that you seem slower?

No, I don't think so. I mean... I don't really do much these days, so I'm mostly just sitting in my room anyway. But when I do get up or do something, I don't feel like I'm moving in slow motion or anything. And nobody has pointed anything like that out to me, either.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My weight has stayed pretty much the same. I haven't really gained or lost anything.
Have you ever thought about hurting yourself or ending your life?
No, I haven't. I don't... I don't really have thoughts like that. I've never wanted to hurt myself or end my life.
Do you often feel worthless?
No, not really. I mean... I know I'm not doing much right now, just being at home, but I don't sit around feeling worthless or anything. I just don't really have thoughts like that about myself.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't hear or see?
No, I haven't. I mean, I know some people talk about that kind of thing, but I've never heard any voices or seen anything that wasn't there. It's just... normal, I guess.
Do you feel anxious or nervous most of the time?
No, I don't think so. I mean... I don't really feel nervous or anxious about things. I'm usually just pretty calm most of the time, I guess.
Do you feel like you're resting or sleeping more than you used to?

No, I don't think so. I sleep about the same as I always have. I mean... I'm at home most of the day, so I might sit around on the couch or whatever, but I'm not actually sleeping or resting more than usual. It's just the normal amount for me.
Do you feel like you're restless or fidgety, or have trouble sitting still?
Not really. I can sit still just fine. Like I said before, I spend a lot of the day just sitting on the couch anyway, so... no, I don't really get restless or feel like I need to keep moving around.
Do you think your lack of motivation and energy affects how actively you move or engage in physical activities?

I don't really know. I mean... I don't do a lot of physical things to begin with. Like I said, I mostly just sit around the house. I don't really think it's because I don't have energy or anything... I just don't have anywhere to go or anything I need to be doing.
Can you think of anything that you used to look forward to, but no longer do?

I guess... well, I used to knit a lot. And I kept a journal, and I liked going for walks. But now... I just can't make myself do any of that anymore. I mostly just sit in my room. I don't even change my clothes. When my mom comes in and asks what's wrong, I just... I barely even have the energy to give her an answer. I just don't care about doing those things now.
Do you feel like your body is heavy or hard to move, or like it's an effort to lift your arms or legs?
No, it doesn't really feel heavy. Like I said, I just sit there. It's not that I can't move my arms or legs or that it's hard to lift them... I just don't have any reason to.
Do you feel like it's an effort to initiate or start any physical activity?

Not really. I mean... it's not like I try to get up and do something and it's too hard to start. I just don't even try in the first place. I just don't have any desire to do anything, so I just stay sitting there.
Do you feel like you're doing things more slowly than you used to, even if it's just small tasks like getting dressed or eating?

No, I don't think I'm doing things slower. I mean... I don't really get dressed much anyway, like I mentioned. But when I do eat, or if I actually do something, it doesn't feel slow. It just feels like a normal speed, I guess. I just... I just don't do those things very often.
Do you find that your feelings or energy levels change at certain times of the year?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. It doesn't seem to matter what time of year it is. Summer or winter... it's all just the same to me. I just always feel like this, where I don't have the desire to do anything, no matter what month it is.
